events.title: Pride Month: We Are All FIERCE! An Interactive BMCC Community Mural
events.description:
Maite Nazario is a multidisciplinary artist from Guatemala and Puerto Rico. Their artistic practice focuses on storytelling and documenting lived experiences through surrealism, creating art that honors the magic of life and nature while documenting the queer immigrant experience.

For Nazario, this artistic practice is also an offering of devotion to Mother Earth. They have exhibited their work in Atlanta, New York, San Juan, Guatemala, and Santo Domingo, and have created installations across the United States. Their practice includes painting, muralism, animation, illustration, and mixed media installations. Nazario’s art serves as a testament to the brilliance and resilience of their people.

See a list of all Pride Month events.

In case of questions, contact the Center for Belonging and Inclusion at belonging@bmcc.cuny.edu or (212) 220-8165.

events.title: Free Workshop: Microsoft PowerPoint (Students Only)
events.description:
Do you want to Learn PowerPoint? Need Help Getting Started?

Microsoft PowerPoint is useful for developing a slide presentation and is currently one of the most commonly used slide-based presentation programs available. The workshop is designed to introduce students to creating professional presentations using Microsoft PowerPoint.

In this workshop, you will learn how to:

  • Explore the functionality of the ribbon
  • Create slides
  • Add, remove, and rearrange slides
  • Change slide layouts designs
  • Save themes and templates
  • Insert and format images, videos, charts from excel, smart art, links and shapes
  • Apply animation and transitions to each slide
  • Share and collaborate on presentations
  • How to screen record, create a voice over the presentation
  • Export presentations as video, PDF, or JPEG files

Join us for a Zoom workshop. The Meeting ID is: 4273010391

and IN-PERSON (Room S510G)

Looking forward to seeing you there!

The Learning Resource Center provides a variety of online workshops and tutoring options for BMCC students.

For more information, please contact Leticia Dinkins at ldinkins@bmcc.cuny.edu.

events.title: Macaulay Honors College: a Pathway to Honors Bachelor’s Education & Scholarship
events.description:
Join us to learn about CUNY’s Macaulay Honors College and its Friedman Transfer Scholars Program – a pathway for eligible associate students to transfer to Macaulay Honors College right after completing their 2-year degree.

Why to consider Macaulay:

  • We have locations at Baruch, Brooklyn, City, CSI, Hunter, John Jay, Lehman and Queens
  • We offer a full tuition scholarship and other financial support
  • You can start your honors bachelor education while finishing your associate degree
  • We have a dedicated network of student support professionals

For more information, visit the Academic Advisement and Transfer Center website and Email: aatc@bmcc.cuny.edu or call: (212) 220-8315.

events.title: Dream University Wall: Design Your Own Pennant
events.description:
Dream big and showcase your future!

Students are invited to design a pennant representing their dream college or university and add it to our Dream University Wall. This interactive event encourages students to explore transfer possibilities, set educational goals, and visualize their future beyond BMCC.

Whether you already have a specific school in mind or are still discovering your options, this is a fun and creative way to celebrate your transfer aspirations and connect with the possibilities ahead.

For more information, visit the Academic Advisement and Transfer Center website and Email: aatc@bmcc.cuny.edu or call: (212) 220-8315.
